newsitem.title: USA: Murphy Oil names Deltic unit officers.
newsitem.headline: Murphy Oil names Deltic unit officers.

text.p: Murphy Oil Corp said on Tuesday it had named Robert Nolan chairman of the board of directors and Ron Pearce chief executive and director of its Deltic Timber Corp unit, which is set to be spun off to shareholders by year end.
Nolan is the managing partner of Munoco, a privately-held natural resources company, and has over 25 years experience in timberland management, Murphy Oil said.
Pearce, who has been president of the Deltic unit since 1993, will continue in that role in addition to being CEO, the company said.
The company also named R. Madison Murphy, chairman of Murphy Oil, to the board of Deltic Timber.

Other directors named were William Rosoff, partner at the law firm of Davis Polk & Wardwell; professional forester O.H. Darling; Eric Heiner, who operates a real estate development and investment firm; stockbroker Alex Lieblong; the Rev. Canon Christoph Keller III; and John Shealy, past president of the Louisiana Forestry Association.
